partition.fifty_client_design: 1,000 examples per client; 550 dominant-class and 50 from each other class; five dominant clients per class

selection: uniform without replacement each round; one schedule shared by methods
synchronization: selected clients catch up by ordered replay or the smaller dense checkpoint; selected clients receive the current round update; a terminal catch-up makes all registered clients exact
traffic: initial model, selected-client requests, packet headers, addresses, signs or float values, catch-up, and terminal exact synchronization
reference_reuse: m10_k10 imports the frozen P19 seed-zero runs after seed and horizon checks
extension_rule: consider ten matched seeds only after the m50_k10 pilot is stable, within one accuracy point of dense, uses less total traffic, and does not use checkpoints for at least 90 percent of nonempty syncs
